# Joseph

## Overview

- **Gender:** male (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P57](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0057)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Joe  <sub>[v2 XII A Jonah Day P11](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0011)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Joseph is a calico beastie with a coat of many colors. He features white legs marked with black spots, a gray back with a large yellow patch on one side and a black patch on the other, and a yellow tail with a gray tip.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P56](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0056), [v3 ch.Relationships P57](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0057), [v3 ch.Interlude P18](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0018)_

## Personality

Joseph is a naturally meek and inoffensive individual. He also possesses a sociable disposition.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P57](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0057)_

## History

Named Joseph because of his coat of many colors, he originally belonged to a dear friend of [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) who moved to [Vancouver](../codex/places.md#vancouver). He moved into Patty's Place alongside [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) and the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md). After engaging in repeated battles with the household's stray cat, [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), Joseph eventually became close friends with him.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P2](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0002), [v3 ch.Relationships P44](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0044), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 ch.Relationships P55](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0055), [v3 ch.Relationships P56](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0056), +3 more_

### [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/joseph--rusty.md)

Joseph lives with [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) at Patty's Place following Aunt Jamesina's move into the household. Initially, the two engaged in repeated battles and were sworn enemies upon meeting. Over time, their dynamic changed completely as they became close friends who even slept on the same cushion together.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P2](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0002), [v3 ch.Relationships P44](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0044), +4 more_
